title: Property Tax Escrow Withheld from a New HECM Scheduled Payment
content:
**Withholding.** Added to the withholdings from a new Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) scheduled payment is a property tax escrow that builds, a twelfth at a time, the property tax bill falling due a year after the next one.

| Records of the loan | Monthly property tax escrow |
|---|---|
| Cedarline advanced property tax on the loan (a property tax advance in the borrower's Property Charge Advance Repayment records) on a payment date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date | the total of the property tax advanced in that window, divided by 12 |
| none advanced in that window, but a set-aside on the loan (Set-Aside Accounts) is depleted with an annual property tax above 0.00 | that annual property tax, divided by 12 |
| neither | nothing |

The escrow is not rounded on its own; only the new scheduled payment is rounded.

*Hypothetical:* 3000.00 of property tax advanced in the window gives an escrow of 250.00 a month; a depleted set-aside with an annual property tax of 2500.00 and no advance in the window gives 208.333…, carried unrounded into the payment.
